Deathcap amplifies AP; Shadowflame supplies15 flat magic penetration/conditional lowHP magic-true am Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Manaflow Band: Earned maximum mana/resource utility; only actual mana conversions can turn it into offensive stats. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: Exactly15 earned stacks give85HP; equipped Riftmaker converts actual bonus HP into AP for this helper. No additional lifesteal damage or free stacks. Cut Down: Eligible non-true damage only while victim is above 60% HP; re-evaluate each packet.

Rune preparation: Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Manaflow: log ten actually earned procs if using its 250 bonus mana; never invent full stacks or mana-to-AP conversion. Bloodline: exactly15 earned legend stacks for85HP; read the actual Riftmaker HP-to-AP result before the scored event.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

kitEvidence.formula:
Renata's Attacks mark enemies for [6] seconds and deal an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.01, perLevel=0.0012, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage if they were unmarked.

Allied champions' Attacks or Abilities consume the mark, dealing [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.01, perLevel=0.0012, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage.

Renata may only have one target marked at a time.
